goal: Test whether the Art Agent can directly produce new Phase 4B gameplay-readable prototype art assets, with prompt/tool/license evidence and Godot-import-ready handoff, without editing gameplay implementation or approving final art direction.

verify.name: Direct art metadata exists
verify.command: test -f art_candidates/phase4b/direct_art/prompts.json && test -f art_candidates/phase4b/direct_art/manifest.json && test -f art_candidates/phase4b/direct_art/manifest.csv && test -f art_candidates/phase4b/direct_art/contact_sheet.md && test -f art_notes/AN-2026W22-007-phase4b-direct-art-production-report.md && test -f owner_reviews/OR-2026W22-007-phase4b-direct-art-KR.md

verify.name: PNG files are parseable prototype assets
verify.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import struct
for path in ['game/assets/phase4b/direct_art/collectible_progression_item_v1.png','game/assets/phase4b/direct_art/hazard_warning_marker_v1.png']:
    with open(path, 'rb') as f:
        sig = f.read(8)
        assert sig == b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n', path
        length = struct.unpack('>I', f.read(4))[0]
        chunk = f.read(4)
        assert chunk == b'IHDR', path
        data = f.read(length)
        width, height, bit_depth, color_type = struct.unpack('>IIBB', data[:10])[:4]
        assert 128 <= width <= 1024 and 128 <= height <= 1024, (path, width, height)
        assert color_type in (4, 6), (path, 'expected alpha-capable PNG color type', color_type)
print('png ok')
PY

verify.name: Manifest CSV parses
verify.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import csv
path = 'art_candidates/phase4b/direct_art/manifest.csv'
with open(path, newline='') as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
assert len(rows) == 2, rows
for row in rows:
    assert row.get('asset_id') and row.get('role') and row.get('source_png') and row.get('tool_or_model') and row.get('usage_status')
print('csv ok')
PY

verify.name: Godot import metadata is generated without treating .godot as evidence
Owner review brief is decision-ready but not pre-approved
verify.command: rg -n "Decision: pending|BK가 검수할 것|승인 기준|Redirect 기준|Reject 기준|지금 승인하지 않는 것|prototype-only|production asset 승인 아님" owner_reviews/OR-2026W22-007-phase4b-direct-art-KR.md

verify.name: No implementation files changed
verify.command: bash -lc 'changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD -- game/scenes game/scripts game/project.godot); test -z "$changed"'

human_decision_reason: BK/Human Creative Owner must approve, redirect, or reject the newly produced prototype art assets before any implementation Work Package may replace the current placeholder/reused visuals with them.
acceptance_criteria: Art Agent directly produces exactly two new prototype PNG assets: one collectible/progression item and one hazard readability marker or obstacle cue.
Each produced asset is gameplay-readable at prototype scale, has an alpha-capable PNG format, and is not a full background, UI mockup, character portrait, logo, or final production asset.
The collectible asset must not look like a goal, hazard, enemy, currency economy item, or final reward system.
The hazard asset must read as danger or avoidance support without implying enemy AI, combat, health, lives, damage systems, or moving-platform scope.
Prompts, tool/model identity, generation date, source/output mapping, license or usage uncertainty, and prototype-only status are recorded for each asset.
Godot import metadata for the new PNG files is generated or confirmed, while game/.godot/** remains ignored and is not used as evidence.
A Korean owner review brief is created so BK can approve, redirect, or reject the generated assets without reading raw JSON.
No Godot scene, script, project config, Phase 3 assets, schemas, profiles, QA reviews, Learning Cards, lifecycle moves, staging, committing, or pushing are performed by WP-036 execution.
The result is a direct Art production capability test and does not approve final art direction, production/public asset usage, launch readiness, web export, or external testing.
notes: This Work Package intentionally differs from WP-032. WP-032 tested Art Agent reuse packaging. WP-036 tests direct prototype art production by requiring two newly produced gameplay-readable PNG assets plus prompt/tool/license evidence and a Korean owner review surface. If no acceptable external art generation or editing tool is available, WP-036 should be marked blocked rather than replaced with prose-only mock assets.
